verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a dedicated moderation/guardrails API pattern — 'Declare moderation rules directly in your API requests. No separate calls or threshold logic in your code' with a named 'Custom Guardrails' feature — giving developers a concrete gating primitive before acting on model output. This is first-party documented, not just implied via general safety talk. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of moderation accuracy or effectiveness, and more detail on categories/thresholds covered.
